reason: The evidence packet explicitly states that applications under the former Freddie Mac Small Balance Loan (SBL) program were accepted only through April 30, 2026, and that the program was replaced by Conventional Small (loans $2M–$10M) announced April 15, 2026. A new application to the named legacy SBL program on September 7, 2026 is therefore not available, as the intake window for that specific named program has closed. This determination concerns only the availability of the named legacy program for a new application; it does not assess the borrower's eligibility under the successor Conventional Small program or any other product.
missing_information: Full current underwriting criteria for Freddie Mac Conventional Small (the successor program)
Whether any transition or exception process exists for in-flight SBL matters after April 30, 2026
Borrower, sponsor, and property specifics needed to evaluate fit under the successor program
